The frame renders -Net worth ?- then -******- with the CLOSED-eye glyph and -**** ****- beneath. NetWorthCard.tsx matches all three literally: SKINS.light is bg-white, the balance masks to -******- when hideValues and a real figure exists, the change masks to -****- per figure giving -**** ****-, and the eye swaps to WalletIconEyeHidden.
